The `.xls` test fixtures in this directory are copied from
`github.com/jloor/go-excel-reader` v0.3.0, source commit
`4d7a9f10d6d72c5cdbfb57ece9108f703da03579`. The upstream generator creates
them with `xlwt` from small synthetic examples (names, quantities, prices,
dates and booleans); they contain no company or customer data. The upstream
project and its fixtures are distributed under the MIT License. The project
license is included in the dependency module cache and linked from the
dependency declaration in `go.mod`.
